prior_driven_nonidentifiable_diagnostics.note: PRIOR-DRIVEN / NON-IDENTIFIABLE FROM SEC HMW DATA ALONE: dH_agg_ref, K_u(5C), and dH_u trade off inside k_eff(T) = f_U(T) * k_agg(T). Reported for diagnostic transparency only; never gated.

dH_agg_vs_dS_agg_ensemble_correlation.explanation: Strong positive enthalpy-entropy compensation (r ~ +0.99) arises physically because SEC data tightly constrain dG_agg_ref = dH_agg_ref - T_ref * dS_agg_ref at 5 °C while leaving the partitioning between dH_agg_ref and dH_u partially collinear.

excursion_verdict_evaluation.evaluation_subset: test_lots_excursions_only (split='test', n=80; calibrated on val_lots_excursions, n=40)

physical_validity_and_15c_audit.training_protocol: Models trained strictly on pulls <= 3.0 months (0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3M) of the 100 training lots

hybrid_lumry_eyring_ode.note: Zero physical violations by construction (strictly positive Lumry-Eyring rate constants and bounded positive dH_agg / dH_u).

shelf_life_vs_truth_100_test_lots.ich_q5c_q1e_regulatory_note: ICH Q5C is the primary regulatory standard for therapeutic biologics (requiring real-time, real-temperature stability data); ICH Q1E statistical confidence-bound and ANCOVA batch-poolability (p=0.25) methods are capped at observed_months + 6.0 months.
shelf_life_vs_truth_100_test_lots.shelf_life_validity_statement: Extrapolation guard enforces strict capping at observed + 6 months per ICH Q1E; late-pull residual checks evaluate ongoing model adequacy.
